answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 25197 Country: India Title: I am going for umrah catching a flight from mumbai to jeddah via yemen(sana) ......can i wear ihram in yemen Question: I am going for umrah catching a flight from mumbai to jeddah via yemen(sana) ......can i wear ihram in yemen Answer ID: 25197 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1365/1365/M=1431) Yes, you can wear ihram in Yemen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
